assessment.quality: the weakest of the three reviewers tried: most lenient (23/27 ACCEPT), lowest W3 agreement, one role-confusion failure, misses both qwen3.8 catches, one minor valid catch of its own. The second-family hypothesis (different blind spots) did not pay off: it shares both of qwen3.8's misses.
assessment.cost: 7 steps median but 239 s per review on the CPU worker (slower than Qwen3.6 at 119 s), driven by much larger contexts; verdict turns 6 of 27 - it would trip the window's reviewer-health rule.
assessment.recommendation: do not pursue Gemma 4 26B-A4B as the reviewer. Rank after three trials: qwen3.8-nothink (pre-registered) ~ Qwen3.6-35B-A3B + read-first (equal quality, cheaper per step) > Qwen3.6 alone (fast, hallucinates) > Gemma 4 26B-A4B (lenient, integration quirks). Laguna XS 2.1 remains untried (HIP risks); not worth a trial before the round-2 window.
